steps.name: cursed traces
steps.objective: Talk to [Anastasia] in “Atlantis” and check out Atlantis’ past at the Chimaera Institute.

lines.text: (Atlantis, an underwater city arrived on a submersible. Behind the fishy smell of water, you can feel a strange atmosphere that cannot be found on land.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Atlantis... . I think Mayor Anastasia said she was around here somewhere... .
Who is there? I feel like I’m seeing this for the first time… .
(As the stranger appears, a woman in a black coat in front of the building approaches. For some reason, I feel a coolness from her unwavering expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I am Adventurer %s who came to Atlantis through Mr. Gatia Su’s introduction… no see.
If it's Gatia... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: If so, you've come to the right place. I am Anastasia, the mayor of Atlantis.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: So what do you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He seems quite uncomfortable.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll tell you. I have Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Anastasia briefly that you are looking for Iris along with Hejong's name.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Iris Livier… .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: The last descendant of the legendary Der clan... . He went on a journey to confront the Demon King, and is currently missing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Iris?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Of course I know. I have met him in person and helped him with his work.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You don't know much about Iris. perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You might not know. anyhow… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? The silence just now….)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Iris Yang's travel shook the world that had been quiet for a long time and brought about many changes.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: It's hard to put into words, but what's certain is that many people are feeling 'confused'.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't really know what you're talking about. Are you saying you are helping me?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I think I can only help you a little bit, not everything. I have no clue where it is, but I don't know where Miss Iris went... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Are you okay with this being the past?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Iris Sheep headed to my hometown Midgard. It was clearly said that they were going to Asgard using the orbital elevator, ‘Bifrost’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Midgard… .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Getting to Midgard will be more difficult than you think. So we need a map.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying you are making a map?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Yes, so I would like you to carry out one of my requests.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Beyond Atlantis, there is a place called the Chimaera Research Institute. It is a place that symbolizes the sins of Atlantis in the past... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I would like you to bring me an artifact from the center of that place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is it?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: If you go there, you will find something like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think he's hiding something. Maybe I should go first...)
(When I look to a place where the atmosphere is unusual, I see someone surrounded by monsters.)
Hey, is there anyone there? I know it all exists! Save me!
(A woman waves her hand and asks for help. Her voice is full of playfulness, considering she is asking for help.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...is this really okay?)
What are you doing? I want help!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute!
(The moment he tries to save the woman by pushing away the monster, the woman's eyes change. Huge bolts shoot out from the crossbow she was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Amazing... .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Come to your senses. You agreed to help me, but are you going to lose your mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.
(After a while, all the monsters in front are defeated. Some seem to have run away.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Phew, it's over. Thanks to you, I survived.
(The woman holding the crossbow smiles brightly and offers to shake hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? But why were you here?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Are you Adventurer employed by Atlantis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I received a request.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I have a similar request. I've been asked to investigate the situation here at the Chimaera Institute.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But I never even thought it would be a place like this. It was dangerous, but it was my fault for biting into it.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Mayor Anastasia didn't say anything like this. joy. Don’t you think it’s too easy to use people?
(The woman holding the crossbow continues to complain.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Oh, sorry. Did I talk too long? When I looked closely, I saw that you seemed to have good skills. Come with me.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I won't hold you back too much. I'm surprisingly useful, so let's go together. huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, this seems to be harder and harder than I thought... .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't decline. Isn’t good something good?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I said it was lab work, so let’s go together.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Then please take care of me. %s.
(As we head toward the center of the lab, a woman holding a crossbow talks non-stop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: My sister was really mean, to this extent? Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: By the way, the essence of ancient Atlantean science and technology is gathered here! It's called Chimera Labs!

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: It's humid, smells weird, hurts my eyes, and is full of strange things. This is not a place worthy of this noble body!

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I thought there would be something shiny and precious, but it wasn't what I expected and I was exhausted... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened here?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: That's right. What happened? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Suddenly, Aoichi’s cherry blossoms come to mind. Oh, I miss you. It was really nice to sit in front of the lake and feel the cool breeze and flower petals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The cherry tree lakeside.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Yeah, I used to live there. If it's a memory, it's a memory... . I don't know if the kid is doing well.
(The woman holding the crossbow can be seen smiling. It is a happy smile as if she is thinking of a special person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You'll be fine, right? Sorry for talking to myself. So shall we go now? Let's hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: (Hehe, if it’s too late, it won’t be fun.)
(The woman with the crossbow is silent for a long time, then raises her hand as if she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You are very quiet. Then can I talk about it? Let's be quiet because I'm a bit bored... . It will be fun for you to listen too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's information about where you're going to research, that's great.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Yeah, I thought you might like it too. Here. It's a truly unpleasant place. Atlantis is full of original sin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Original sin?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: The Atlanteans, obsessed with science, ended up touching things they shouldn't have touched. I did a terrible thing to the giants here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: The giants that remained here sparsely were not the same as they are now. Even though it was large, it was a being that was no different from a human.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They lived quietly deep in the mountains or wilderness, together with other creatures like themselves... . The Atlanteans caught them... .
(The woman holding the crossbow tries to show something with a hand gesture, but stops.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Horribly, it made it what it is now. Should I call it a monster? .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: And based on the results, they tried to become stronger. Did those people really try to become gods?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did that really happen?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Don’t you believe it too? so do i? anyhow! The price was a disaster bordering on destruction.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: The As gods judged those who wanted to become like the As gods, the owners of the heavenly city. Even the Assin tribe would have been horrified.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They would have never thought that what they did for this place would turn out to be so terrible.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Human greed goes around anyway. Like their past, like this land’s past, and like the future that will happen someday.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Because of their judgment, the city fell into the sea. If you saw it in person, it would probably have been a pretty cool sight, right? That's really cool. If you commit a sin, you must be judged.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But, those people... .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Oh no. Anyway, for now, let’s not forget the sins of the past, so I think the research center is being preserved as is.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But it doesn't make sense. If you were going to take responsibility, you shouldn't have left the hateful giants here unattended.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Hypocrites... . Maybe I'm a hypocrite too. I hoped not, but I'm walking down the street like a criminal.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Hahaha, was that too serious? Sometimes I'm like this

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't worry too much about what I said. Seriously, don't pay attention. Okay? Well, shall we go now? Because there isn't much left.
(A woman holding a crossbow walks forward first. Her face is filled with a lonely expression as she passes by. It is a contrast to the way she was talking excitedly just a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, I feel like I had more to say. Oh, I don't know. Let's settle the matter here and then go back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, let’s go together!
(As soon as you enter the space, the steps of a woman holding a crossbow stop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: That's right. This is the center of the lab. Does it feel a little more stringent than other places?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see more machines... .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You said there was something to find here, right? Then I'm looking for it. In the meantime, I will also be taking care of my work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Hehe… .
(The woman with the crossbow hums and looks inside. She then begins to manipulate some device inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So let’s find out… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are there so many lines here? You almost fell... . ok?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There is a suspicious box in front of you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this it? Chimera corpuscle box… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It definitely looks like this, but it's empty. I wish it was around here... .

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Are you looking for something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I can't see it.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Are you talking about this?
(The woman holding the crossbow takes something out of her arms and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that… . I think it was in a box. Could you please give me a moment to check it out?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: What if you don’t like it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Do you know what this is? A ‘Chimera’ body that creates dolls that resemble ‘humans’.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Why did Atlantis create something like this? And why was it put there like that? To make it later? I guess I still haven't given up my desire to become a god.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: It's not like we don't know how pitiful it is to be a being created by humans who are trying to corrupt us. The proof is here.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I know it's a shame. When I see you asking me to find this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You… .
(The atmosphere of the woman holding the crossbow changes. A strange sense of discomfort is felt.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Okay, I'll give it to you. Now, take it.
(A woman holding a crossbow throws the object she was holding at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, this… . It's broken.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Listen carefully. Don't be angry. I wrote this. Hehe, Anastasia, tell that woman clearly.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Choen Palm used a Chimera socket. What kind of expression will Anastasia make when she finds out? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This feeling of fear is oppressing my mind...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes, I am Choen Palm. Someone who will make a hole in that stuffy head.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I feel bad for holding on like that... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I'll end this quickly. Consider it your bad luck to meet me here!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Wow, it's pretty good.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's okay as a play partner, but why don't you fall down like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this to me?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Are you asking because you don’t know? If so, let me make it clear. huh? what?
(Choen Palm stops attacking and looks outside. It seems to sense someone's presence.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're an uninvited guest.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What on earth is going on here... . Da, you Choen Palm?!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: She is as tactless and annoying as ever.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You have no right to say such things!
(Anastasia raises her sword and lunges at Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where did Anastasia's sword come from? Choen Palm also dodged that sword in an instant...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: This is my first time seeing a black sword, but not for me. You know, Anastasia.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What on earth are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What you see is what it is. I was just interested in Atlantis' ugly and rotten past.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's all annoying, but I'll stop here. I'm going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Listen up, Adventurer, who doesn't know where you're from. I commend you for withstanding my attack. Don’t misunderstand, I’m not leaving because you’re difficult to deal with.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: And don't even think about looking for Iris. Because you'll never find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you think I can't find Iris?
(Choen Palm's expression is slightly distorted, but it quickly returns to its relaxed appearance.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Think however you like.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Then I'm going, bye~.
(Suddenly, an unknown darkness gathers around. Choen Palm hurriedly enters the darkness as if being swallowed.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: It's gone... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You're still a woman who can't let down her guard. By the way, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I see. Sorry, but could you please explain what happened here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain what happened to Anastasia.)
(Anastasia seems to notice something and begins to touch the devices inside.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Choen Palm touched… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What Choen Palm was aiming for was information about the [Homunculus] project... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Sorry. that… . Oh, no. Let me tell you. This is what happened in Atlantis, and now that you know, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What is the Homunculus Project? This is a project to create [pseudohumans] using the Chimera corpuscles that we requested you to retrieve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you ask me to get it?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Because I wanted to keep it properly. To reflect on the past... . However, Choen Palm seems to be trying to take advantage of that.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You're doing something like that when you have such a negative view of this place... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Looking at the status of the case, it seems like it happened a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I don't know what Choen Palm will do now, and there's nothing I can do here. Shall we go back first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s go back to Atlantis. Although Choen Palm’s words bother me….)

steps.name: Back to Heukwolseong
steps.objective: Talk to [Anastasia] in “Atlantis” and return to “Aoichi”.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I've gathered some information, but I still don't know why Choen Palm is doing this.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I will continue to investigate as is. So you'd better go your own way. And here's the map... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks for the map. Then where should we go? Because it’s about finding Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should we go?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since we definitely talked about cherry blossoms... . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: There's a place that came to mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. Maybe I can find out... .

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Then please be careful... .

steps.name: Battle of Owl Castle
steps.objective: Listen to the detailed story from [Black Moon Castle] in front of “Black Moon Castle” and enter “Owl Castle”. And help [Princess Black Moon] at the “Owl Castle Watchtower” inside.

lines.text: (The front of Black Moon Castle is a mess. The lord of Black Moon Castle seems to be thinking hard about something outside the castle with a troubled expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Ah, no matter how much she is my daughter, she does as she pleases.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Seongju.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Oh, %s! What are you doing?! Welcome!! Thanks to you, I am healthy. Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Hahaha. Cluck cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure you're okay?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'm fine. Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I thought it would come back even if it didn't, but I never thought it would be today. I'm so lucky too.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: How have you been? Seeing that you came back to Black Moon Castle, something must have happened, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Ah, I don’t know if I can tell you this… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Please tell me. Because it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say it's okay, then... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell the story of meeting Choen Palm to the Lord of Black Moon Castle.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I guessed it, but… . Well, it was that kid's story. I mean, I met that kid.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I don't want to tell the princess, but the child still wants it... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Then, you will deliver the message directly to the princess. First of all, I think the princess must be grateful to you before she will listen to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Directly to the princess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you're looking at me unfavorably, but... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: On the contrary, it worked out well. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think the Lord of the castle is going to tell me to do something...)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Now the princess is defeating the remnants of evil forces hiding in the Owl Castle. I said, “Father, I will take care of everything,” and went in, but… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Still, I'm worried. ha ha ha. Aren’t good things good?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All we have to do is go inside and help the princess, right?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: That's right. Can I ask you a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Please. And I'm sorry. The princess will definitely react strongly. Because I don’t have any bad intentions towards you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll tell it to the princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come back.
(After a while, you see Princess Black Moon. She seems to be surrounded by assassins and in a standoff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Uh, you… . This is too much of a coincidence. Are you here to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is clearly a crisis situation, but you are asking so calmly...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will help you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't let your guard down!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh.
(Princess Black Moon's bow accurately hits the assassin who appears behind %s.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Phew, that's enough here. I'll take care of it. If you want to help, go after the runaway remnants of the Baekgundang.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: And… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Okay, just in case you don't know, I'll tell you. Tengu is bound by a spell. So, if you really meet me, run away right away, okay?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Because I'm not an opponent you can deal with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: … Okay, then go ahead.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: You… . That's a pretty good skill. Do you mind if I look at it one more time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Are you okay over there?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Are you still worried about me in this situation?
(The tengu looks at %s and feels a sign of affection.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tengu! Stop it!

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: I thought the princess would come, but it was too early.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Eh?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: I will stop if the princess wants.
(The tengu steps back, closes its eyes, and mutters in a low voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… . You got smaller.
(Princess Black Moon looks at the shrunken Tengu with a puzzled expression.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tengu, weren’t you controlled by witchcraft?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Hmm, princess. Aren't you underestimating me? It is unreasonable for the princess's parents and ancestors to control me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then what was the fight that gave off powerful energy just a moment ago?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: It is said that the child seemed to have the talent to become a tengu, so they briefly tested him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have the talent to become a tengu?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Haha, don't worry about that. There will be a lot of work to do in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Phew, I was worried for no reason.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Thank you, princess. You are becoming a more and more wonderful woman.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Well, don’t say things like that!!
(The Tengu talks about various things with Princess Black Moon and then looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Tengu? Why is that?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: You… , doesn’t he have something to tell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you hesitating about? Just say it. Because I will listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell the story of meeting Choen Palm to Princess Black Moon and Tengu.)
(As Princess Black Moon's face turns slightly pale, the tengu checks her condition.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Princess, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tengu, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Okay, I got it. In seconds.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tengu, please be quiet for a moment.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There must be a reason for Choen. There must be a reason! Don't say anything bad... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's all because Iris, the child did something wrong. Because the world is in crisis due to the foolishness of Iris!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I definitely saw it. The appearance of many [Demon Lords] who appeared from beyond time and space because of Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth did the princess see...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen wanted to prevent that. The things I'm doing now... .

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Princess… . You know, right?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Be quiet, Tengu!! I don't know!! I don’t want to hear it!! We need to find Choen. I don't know what you're doing, but if I don't go and look at it... . perhaps… .
(As soon as the Black Moon Princess finishes speaking, she hurries out.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Poor princess... . Clinging to words you don't want to believe... . I should have roasted that flame chick properly when he showed up.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: It might be a little okay. The operation of the sky is never bad.
(The tengu watches %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tengu?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: If you ever meet Princess Black Moon again, please be her friend. Although he pretends to be strong, he is a delicate child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I will.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Hurry and chase after the princess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess… .

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Okay, goodbye this time. Anyway, it looks like we'll meet again soon, so I'll see you then.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: That's right. Go see Tamori. There will be work for you to do.
(As soon as the words are finished, the tengu disappears on the wind blowing from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… , gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, this wind is soft... . But what is my job?

steps.name: Whereabouts of Princess Black Moon
steps.objective: Talk to [Tamori] and go to [Sino] in “Midgard.”

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: I have to chase after the princess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The person chasing Ame was Tamori, right?)

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: Ah, you. You just went to see the princess, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but what's going on?

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: The princess got angry and left. They said I had to meet Choen... . What happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Tamori, don't push him.

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: My lord, I will go and fetch the princess. If the princess becomes that angry... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Phew. You have work to do here.

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: … yes. Then the princess's job is... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: %s, you chase the princess. Since it's related to Choen, you won't be able to see or hear anything right now.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I think there's something the princess hasn't told anyone about. I don't know if they had just simply told Choen's story... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: At first, I learned something about what the child was trying to do... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Then maybe it has something to do with Iris... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Maybe so, maybe not. What is certain is that the princess is going to meet Choen and go to the place where she was with Miss Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Where is that place?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Midgard was about to go to meet the As gods to get answers... . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: If you are not sure where the princess has gone, go see Shino in the tavern. Since you are from Aoichi, you will know if I tell you that I sent you here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'm sorry for asking you this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I'll go right away.
(A noisy bar in Midgard. Inside, a beautiful woman wearing traditional Aoichi clothing is busy welcoming customers.)

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Shino? I'm at Black Moon Castle... .

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Lord Seong, what is going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, he asked me to say hello on the way.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I see. Still, Adventurer seems curious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where Princess Black Moon has gone?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: The princess isn't looking for someone named Choen, is she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I don't know either, so there's no need to continue. Instead, I'll tell you something else.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Not long ago, I heard a story about a woman with short hair entering Bifrost. I saw him holding a crossbow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shino, thank you. I'll go straight to Bifrost.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I was going to tell you that the orbital elevator is broken, but you're already gone... .

steps.name: blue phoenix
steps.objective: Go to the “Throne of Valhalla” at the top of “Bifrost”.

lines.text: (The summit of Valhalla, a place full of an unknown and ominous feeling. Choen Palm is looking up at the sky with a distorted expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: How did you manage to come this far? Why are there so many customers visiting me today?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I wish the princess hadn't come... . It's the worst.
(Choen Palm looks at the fallen Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen, don’t do that… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Princess, I'm going to get rid of you because you're in the way ♬ Hold on even if it hurts, okay?
(Choen Palm laughs and punches the approaching Black Moon Princess in the abdomen.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ugh, choen… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Good girl, princess. For now, just fall asleep like this.
(Choen Palm lays the unconscious Black Moon Princess to one side and looks at the uninvited guest, Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ominous power I felt here… belonged to Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Welcome to Valhalla. Adventurer sung by the Der people.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: How did you manage to climb up here? If Iris was selected, it sure looks different.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You came this far believing that you were ‘justice’, right?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You have no self-awareness. I don't know what I'm doing, I don't know what it's for,

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Just take down all the beings that stand in your way. You won't know the truth about the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Truth of the world?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes, the truth.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The good and evil, light and shadow that this world knows... . It's all a contradiction. Maybe it's better for a brat like you not to know.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Were the monsters that died in this [world] really [evil] that deserved to be hunted to you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's dirty.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's dirty. It's dirty.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's dirty. It's dirty. It's dirty.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I feel so dirty!!
(Blue flames rise from Choen Palm’s body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Since you came as a sinner, I will punish you properly. Now, Adventurer, I have a gift for you.
(The blue flame grows bigger and begins to surround Choen Palm. After a while, a huge bird flies inside it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, that… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't say thank you. This is natural.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I will give you the flame of discipline and the judgment of purification... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Die here like you are!
(At the end of the close fight, the blue flame contained in the bird gradually fades. After a while, Choen Palm is revealed little by little within it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the end?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Do you think this is the end? Arrogant thing... .
(With the voice of Choen Palm, the faded blue flame burns again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: This is so stupid. You don't even know who you were fighting right now, right? How can you hold on like that without even understanding... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Now that things are like this, shall we try out our newfound power? Can you survive this time too?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I will show you Agashura’s true form.
(A huge movement of power is felt at the end of Choen Palm's words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a completely different power that I’ve never felt before. It’s like….)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Do you feel the abyss? Can you feel it?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That deep, deep feeling of an abyss? It feels like someone is reaching out, and it gives me goosebumps. What the hell is this….)
(An unknown force approaches %s and begins to surround him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soo, I'm out of breath.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I feel how unfair the justice and providence you have believed in are.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: And crawl under the darkness. For the rest of my life, it can never happen again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, my consciousness is fading….)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: [Stop it.]
(With the sound of someone's voice in his blurred consciousness, %s's legs give out. Then Choen Palm begins to scream and suffer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what is it? It got better, but... . Is it an auditory hallucination? But Choen Palm… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ugh, wow!! go away!! This doll!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, that’s… .
(Choen Palm I see a blurry figure of a boy in front of me. It feels like an illusion, like a soul.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris? No. It feels similar to Iris, but... that kid is not Iris.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Dare, dare… . On the topic of dolls… . Get out of my head!! I thought it was deleted with crack, I thought it was deleted, why are you out there!!
[…] Do I still look like the doll you made? Poor child… .]

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up. Shut up… .
[…] Hello.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s gone….)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Damn… . Cluck, cluck.
(Blood begins to flow from Choen Palm's mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the beginning… .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't call my name!
(Choen Palm bites its lip and tries to stumble out.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Consider me lucky to be stepping down like this.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Because next time everyone involved will die. No, you have to die!! Cluck, cluck… .
(Choen Palm stares at the fallen Princess Black Moon for a moment and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Choen’s power? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And that child who appeared earlier... . Oh, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Seconds, seconds... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why is it like that... .
(Princess Black Moon fainted from sobbing, so her voice can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, let's take the princess out. If you go to Shino... .
(As the Black Moon Princess is supported, the tears forming around her eyes flutter like the cherry blossom petals seen in Aoichi and fall down the track.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess… .
